metadata.title: Introducing our newest supply partner, Quimivita - Omya Personal Care
metadata.description: Omya is pleased to announce our national partnership with innovative supplier, Quimivita. Their natural and sustainable product offering is an exciting complement to our existing portfolio and provides a unique alignment with Omya’s focus in the Personal Care industry. Quimivita has served the industry for more than 5 decades and their commitment to innovation is proven in their comprehensive product line that includes anti-aging, antioxidant, […]
